coverage.method: Manual transcription from rendered pages; native text was only an aid and invisible rows were excluded.
coverage.included: All visible dated and A DEFINIR event rows in Annex1/Annex2 and operative RR435 date/scope rules; cross-annex corroborations grouped.
coverage.excluded: Hidden/stale native-text rows, calendar grid day numbers, signatures/contact addresses. No external official-currentness or legal verification.
limitations: These supplied documents do not establish the latest authoritative university calendar.
Annex2 is an academic organization agenda, not an explicit separate modality.
A broad exam window is not an actual available exam appointment.
Unresolved date variants and literal source anomalies must not be silently resolved.
